claim.summary: Pair product rank floor: in the charged character window (over F containing F_4, multigraphs included), for s pairwise disjoint edge pairs with psi_i of support exactly the pair, pi the largest number of paired edges at a vertex, a binary t-by-s matrix C, q_j = sum_i C_ji m_(psi_i) and P = prod_(j<=t)(1 + q_j), with K >= 1, K + 2t <= D, pi < epsilon/2, rho = (epsilon - 2pi)/(2(epsilon - pi)), beta = (eK/(rho(m - 2s)))^rho < 1 and eta = (1 + 2 beta^(epsilon - pi))^n - 1, the rank c_P(K) of f -> R_D(P f) on degree <= K satisfies: (a) if C has rank t, c_P(K) >= (1 - eta) B_(m-2t)(K) >= (1 - eta)(1 - 2t/(m - K))^K B_m(K); (b) if s >= K + t, with zeta_C = sum over nonzero lambda in F_2^t of (2K/m)^|lambda^T C|, then for every b with 0 < b < s - K - t + 1, c_P(K) >= (1 - b/(s - K - t + 1))^t (1 - eta - zeta_C - s(K/m)^2/b) B_m(K). P's top part is sum over t-sets T of det(C_T) m_(psi_T) (a binary permanent is a determinant in characteristic two); for each character alpha of a good frame whose touched pairs leave C of rank t and whose psi-valued pairs avoid a pivot set T_0, alpha + psi_(T_0) is the leading class of P m_alpha in an order by support, frame and lex with T_0 first, and these classes are distinct and good; (a) uses one pivot set in every frame.
claim.assessment: Working proof by a leading-term triangularity, a frame-wise good-character union bound adapted from lem:pair-occupancy and a Markov bound on the psi-valued pairs, passed by a fresh-context medium reviewer after it found the first statement false for b >= s - K - t + 1; part (a), the reviewer's fixed-pivot suggestion, verified against the proof. The triangularity checked exactly in the cut-free model on 15 small instances with a zero-determinant control.

Ordinary raw V_2 also has its Boolean relations in the kernel. Mixed differences on nonzero patterns of kerC with two selected zero coordinates kill all cross-pair quadratic coefficients; single-pair variations kill linear coefficients; the remaining affine function in z lies in rowspanC. Boolean row annihilation pays2k+4. For k>=1 residual rank>=N_(2q)(2)-k>N_(2q)(2)/2, refuting a universal2^-k moving-current-image bound under averaging too. Let a_i be each binary local charge-violation indicator, z_i the private edge nonzero-state indicator, g_i=z_i+a_i. Eventually h<q. For every constant h-by-q binary C, P_C=product_u(1+(Cg)_u), the full local error rank on the SAME V_K is at least (1-q(15/16)^floor(Delta/8))B_m(K)=(1-o(1))B_m(K). Both fibers of g_i inject through degree floor(Delta/8)-1 by ternary hyperplane character independence and private-state conditioning; tensor injection gives the floor. Paid reference g_i=z_i modulo J turns its prefix into a length-h private-edge conjunction; exact puncturing gives the bound.
